title: wss-guide: no guidance on handling PresenceStatus StateChange
description: The spec lists PresenceStatus as a push-subscribable type (changes to the owner's own PresenceStatus record). The guide covers ChatPresenceEvent (others' presence) and ChatContact/get but says nothing about what a client should do when a StateChange arrives for PresenceStatus. Should it call PresenceStatus/get? Is the /changes pattern the same?
